metadata.name: registry
metadata.description: OCCA Registry program — Company & Agent identity PDAs (Phase 1 MVP)

instructions.name: create_company
docs: Create a new CompanyAccount PDA.
Seeds: `["company", controlling_authority, nonce_le_u32]`
`nonce` lets a single controlling_authority own multiple companies.
Server-side picks the next free nonce per authority. `metadata_uri`
is an off-chain pointer (IPFS / Arweave / HTTPS) — empty string is
allowed for MVP.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The future `controlling_authority` of the company. Required to
sign so a third party can't squat someone else's authority+nonce
PDA. For MVP this is the operator hot wallet.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the new account. May or may not equal `authority`.

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Create a new AgentAccount PDA under an existing company.
Seeds: `["agent", company_pda, agent_index_le_u32]`
`agent_index` is a per-company u32 counter (NOT a UUID) — server
is responsible for picking the next free index. `agent_address` is
the wallet that will sign trace anchors (later phase). For MVP
custody_model=3 (SignToDerive), the FE derives this pubkey via
wallet.signMessage and OCCA never holds the privkey.

accounts.name: company
docs: Existing company. `has_one` enforces that `controlling_authority`
(signer below) matches the field stored on the company.

accounts.name: controlling_authority
docs: Must match `company.controlling_authority`.

errors.name: InvalidCustodyModel
errors.msg: custody_model is not a known variant

fields.name: company
docs: Owning CompanyAccount PDA.

fields.name: agent_address
docs: Wallet that will sign agent-side actions (e.g. commit_trace later).

fields.name: custody_model
docs: See top-of-file mapping.

fields.name: derivation_index
docs: SLIP-0010 hardened derivation index. Reserved for Phase 3 rotation.

fields.name: agent_index
docs: Per-company counter — also part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: role_id
docs: Reference to a role catalog entry (off-chain).

fields.name: adapter_id
docs: Pinned adapter version. Pubkey::default() = unspecified.

fields.name: status
docs: 0=Active, 1=Degraded, 2=Retired.

fields.name: version
docs: Schema version — bump on field changes.

fields.name: controlling_authority
docs: Privileged-class signer for this company.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Pointer to TreasuryAccount PDA (Pubkey::default() until Phase 2).

fields.name: policy
docs: Pointer to PolicyAccount PDA (Pubkey::default() until Phase 2).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp (seconds) at creation.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Seed disambiguator — same authority can own multiple companies.

fields.name: metadata_uri
docs: Off-chain metadata URI (IPFS / Arweave / HTTPS). Bounded by
MAX_METADATA_URI_LEN to keep account size predictable.
